title: Determination of the Resort Credit Applied in One Application on a Granite Ridge Pass Account
content:
Resort credit standing on a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass record is drawn down against the amount the pass account still shows to collect, and this rule fixes how much is applied in one application.

**The pot.** The pot the application is drawn from is the resort credit the pass record shows standing.

**The share drawn.** The whole of the pot is drawn in one application, a share of 100 per cent.

**Credit issued to put a billing error right.** Nothing is held back from the amount drawn on that account.

**A protection premium.** Nothing is held back on that account either.

**The amount applied.** The amount applied is the pot taken at the share drawn and rounded to the cent, less the error credit held back and less the protection premium held back, the two amounts held back being deducted from that rounded figure rather than from the pot; the result is never below zero, never more than the amount the pass account still shows to collect, and is rounded to the cent once at the end.

**The smallest single application.** Where the figure those deductions leave falls below the smallest single application the tier allows, the application is raised to that smallest single application, and where the pot itself or the amount the pass account still shows to collect is smaller than that, the smaller of those two is applied instead; that figure too is never below zero.

### The determination worked through

Hypothetical inputs: a Granite Ridge Summit Pass record showing 300.00 of resort credit standing, a pass account showing 1000.00 still to collect, and a tier whose smallest single application is 25.00.

The pot is 300.00. The whole of it is drawn, which rounded to the cent is 300.00. Nothing is held back on either account, so the figure stands at 300.00. It is not above the 1000.00 the pass account still shows to collect and it is not below zero, so it stands. It is not below the smallest single application of 25.00, so it is not raised. The amount applied is 300.00.

Where the same record showed only 18.00 of credit standing and the pass account showed 1000.00 still to collect, the figure of 18.00 would fall below the smallest single application of 25.00; the smaller of the pot and the amount still to collect is 18.00, which is smaller than 25.00, so 18.00 is applied.
